qa.summary: BA artifacts exist, parse, and describe one coherent parity issue, but they are not suitable for unconditional dev handoff because critical subagent raw-event propagation and structured-result transport contracts remain unproven/underspecified.
qa.user_verbatim_requirement: Happy dev transcript rendering for Bash/tool-call content and subagent lifecycle/content should match current Claude Code rendering when the underlying session source is Codex. Claude Code current rendering is the source of truth.

supported_claims: Codex app-server emits exec_command_end with output/exit_code/duration_ms/status/cwd/command at codexAppServerClient.ts:315-327.
Codex mapper currently drops exec_command_end payload by emitting only tool-call-end call at codex/utils/sessionProtocolMapper.ts:324-328.
Session protocol currently limits tool-call-end output to optional string at sessionProtocol.ts:41-45.
typesRaw normalizes omitted session output to null and is_error false at typesRaw.ts:664-680.
typesRaw drops start/stop lifecycle markers at typesRaw.ts:560-562 and tests assert broad dropping at typesRaw.spec.ts:1871-1904.
Claude mapper/renderers are a reasonable local parity oracle for current Claude Code behavior.

objections.finding: BA requires Codex subagent child text/tool calls to attach to one Claude-equivalent conversation, but the evidence only proves receiverThreadIds on collabAgentToolCall control events. Current commandExecution and agentMessage emissions do not forward threadId/subagent identity, so AC2 may be infeasible from the proven data path.
evidence: packages/happy-cli/src/codex/codexAppServerClient.ts:302-327 emits exec_command_begin/end without thread identity
packages/happy-cli/src/codex/codexAppServerClient.ts:364-372 emits agent_message without thread identity
packages/happy-cli/src/codex/codexAppServerClient.ts:397-408 is the only cited begin path carrying receiverThreadIds
packages/happy-cli/src/codex/utils/sessionProtocolMapper.ts:84-110 resolves subagent only from message.subagent/parent_call_id/parentCallId
objections.recommendation: BA must either prove raw Codex child-thread events arrive with usable identity, or explicitly require app-server propagation of child thread identity before mapper/reducer work.

objections.finding: Context affected_files includes codexAppServerClient.ts, but development_approach.files_to_modify omits it. Because missing child identity/result fields likely originate before the mapper, this omission can send dev into an impossible mapper/UI-only implementation path.
evidence: context.root_cause_analysis.affected_files includes packages/happy-cli/src/codex/codexAppServerClient.ts
context.development_approach.files_to_modify starts at packages/happy-cli/src/codex/utils/sessionProtocolMapper.ts and does not list codexAppServerClient.ts
objections.recommendation: Add codexAppServerClient.ts as an explicit likely modification target or document why no app-server event propagation change is needed.

objections.finding: BA requires a structured ToolCall.result object, but the current session protocol tool-call-end schema only accepts optional string output. The BA phrase that structured fields must remain available if output stays string is not an acceptance-testable transport contract.
evidence: packages/happy-wire/src/sessionProtocol.ts:41-45 defines sessionToolCallEndEventSchema output as z.string().optional()
packages/happy-app/sources/sync/typesRaw.ts:664-680 maps envelope.ev.output directly to tool-result content
context.expected_normalized_contract.codex_bash_tool_result.required_shape requires output/stdout/stderr/exit_code/status/duration_ms/cwd/command/empty_output/source
objections.recommendation: BA must name the transport mechanism: extend schema with a structured field, derive result by joining start/end envelopes, or another exact tested path. Metadata/raw JSON alone must be disallowed.

objections.finding: Golden mapper/normalizer/reducer tests are listed as Should Have even though the diagnosed bug is L4 data-flow loss. Without golden raw-event to envelope to normalized-message expectations, screenshots could pass while result fields or child linkage remain structurally wrong.
evidence: BA spec diagnosis_layer/context says L4
BA spec Should Have says add focused mapper/normalizer/reducer tests
context.expected_normalized_contract defines object and identity requirements that need unit/golden tests
objections.recommendation: Promote focused golden tests for Codex Bash result shape and Codex subagent identity/linkage to Must Have.

objections.finding: BA requires live dev UI screenshots/DOM metrics for closure, but also states no deployment. In this happy-dev environment, live web verification usually requires a safe dev-web rebuild/deploy or an explicit local/HMR verification route; the current wording can contradict QA closure requirements.
evidence: BA Must Have: live QA must use dev UI screenshots/DOM metrics
Context constraints: No production access, deployment, daemon restart, or API-created sessions
Project CLAUDE.md permits rebuilding/deploying happy-web-dev from the worktree for QA while forbidding production deployment
objections.recommendation: Change restriction to no production deployment/services and explicitly allow safe dev-web/local verification as required by happy-dev QA protocol.

objections.finding: AC2 and requirements ask for Codex subagent result/summary parity, but the cited Codex collab_agent_call_end evidence carries status only, not result text/summary. BA does not identify the raw event that supplies a child agent final answer or summary.
evidence: packages/happy-cli/src/codex/codexAppServerClient.ts:412-421 emits collab_agent_call_end with tool/status/senderThreadId/subagent only
BA AC2 requires prompt, result/summary, and child tools through one conversation
objections.recommendation: Identify and cite the raw event carrying subagent result/summary, or explicitly scope summary/result display to data that exists and require child final answer attachment when available.

objections.finding: BA mentions stable CUID2 mapping but does not state the key invariant needed for reducer/sidebar linkage: visible parent tool-call id, args.sessionSubagent when applicable, envelope.subagent, reducer sidechain key, and SidebarAgentConversation messages must point to the same child conversation identity.
evidence: packages/happy-cli/src/claude/utils/sessionProtocolMapper.ts:568-578 uses sessionSubagentForCall as visible call id for hidden parent tool calls
packages/happy-app/sources/sync/reducer/reducer.ts:947-1156 stores sidechain messages by msg.sidechainId and marks owner messages changed
BA expected_normalized_contract names stable CUID2 but not the full linkage invariant
objections.recommendation: Add a Must Have identity invariant and golden test asserting one stable CUID2 links parent card, sidechain messages, child tools, detail, and sidebar.

objections.finding: context.blocking_issues is empty even though QA preconditions still require missing Claude Bash+Agent and Codex subagent routes to be found or UI-created. These are acceptable preconditions, but they should be represented as open validation blockers/preconditions rather than buried with blocking_issues: [].
evidence: context.qa_preconditions lists missing/future Claude Bash+Agent and Codex subagent sample route discovery or UI creation
context.blocking_issues is []
objections.recommendation: Populate blocking_issues or a distinct open_preconditions list so dev/QA cannot mistake the issue as fully sample-provisioned.

objections.finding: Prior mobile/runtime observations are second-hand in the final artifacts and not linked to exact screenshot paths or measured report fields, though BA honestly marks diagnosis completeness as mixed.
evidence: BA Evidence Observed references prior mobile simulation generically
context.prior_attempts references docs/dev/qa-report-20260427-230227-p05.json but final BA evidence does not include screenshot/measurement paths
objections.recommendation: Link exact prior evidence files/fields where available, while preserving live QA as the closure gate.

objections.finding: runCodex.ts appears in affected_files/all_occurrences because it mirrors exec_command_end into the local Ink buffer, but it is not clearly part of Happy web transcript rendering. This is not blocking, but it may distract implementation unless labeled as non-target evidence.
evidence: packages/happy-cli/src/codex/runCodex.ts:538-557 writes event summaries into messageBuffer
development_approach.files_to_modify does not include runCodex.ts
objections.recommendation: Mark runCodex.ts as contextual/non-target unless dev intentionally updates local CLI display parity too.

qa.recommendation: Return to BA for a targeted amendment before dev implementation. Minimum amendment: prove or require Codex child-thread event propagation through codexAppServerClient.ts, define exact structured result transport, promote golden tests to Must Have, clarify dev-web deployment allowance, and list open sample-route preconditions as blockers/preconditions.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex agreed PASS_WITH_OBJECTIONS is defensible only if dev handoff is conditional, but advised FAIL for unconditional dev readiness due to subagent child-event propagation, codexAppServerClient omission, structured result transport, weak golden-test classification, dev deployment wording, unproven subagent result source, missing ID invariant, and underreported preconditions.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Verdict changed from draft pass_with_objections/warning to fail for dev handoff suitability; objections OBJ-1 through OBJ-8 promoted as blockers.

refined_context.recommended_ba_amendment: Produce a revised BA spec/context or addendum resolving OBJ-1 through OBJ-8 before invoking dev.
